properties.site-address: Land West Of Swarland Equestrian Centre, Swarland
properties.notes: Former equestrian centre comprising of an indoor riding arena, associated buildings and infrastructure. Now only utilised for private use and considered surplus and available for redevelopment. An initial application was approved in 2016 to build 15 homes on clearance (15/02656/FUL). A revised proposals was then permitted in 2018 for demolition of the existing buildings and facilities and construction of a scheme of 26 homes (18/02250/FUL). A more recent permission has amended this scheme, increasing the yield to 27 dwellings (19/01637/FUL). Development now under-construction and forecast for completion in the next 5 years.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
